ctx.x: I’ll go back to people will tell me to watch that movie, Zelig, because apparently we have this similar thing. When I connect with someone, I really connect. We share this space, and I can feel them, and it’s not like... It becomes intuitive, it becomes psychic, it becomes all sorts of things, and it will be things that I intuitively know. Sometimes, you have some musicians (especially when we were dealing with the musicians after Hurricane Katrina) that I choose to say... It’s like this incredible, beautiful…
You described it as using “Mr.” or “Miss” or “Sir,” and talking to people in a way...
